       Business

       Our mission

       Establishing a romantic connection is a fundamental human need. Whether its a good date, a meaningful relationship or an enduring marriage. romantic
       connectivity lifts the human spirit. Our mission is to increase romantic connectivity worldwide.

       Who we are

       Match Group is the worlds leading provider of dating products. We operate a portfolio of over 45 brands, including Match, OkCupid. Tinder. Plenty0fFish,
